why: The article gives the route mostly through rivers (Great Zab, Centrites), regions (Corduene, Armenia, Bithynia, Thrace, Ionia) and an unnamed castle and defile. Only Cunaxa, Mount Theches, Trapezus, Sinope, Chrysopolis and Byzantium are pointable places with something that happened there, so fewer than eight stops and no marching dates.
